meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('important').

examples.text: Я тебе утром говорил: не торопись. Это очень важный вопрос.
examples.trans: I told you this morning: don't rush. It's a very important question.

meanings.note: Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to come back, to return', paired with 'возвращаться'.

examples.text: Так, не шумим. Я скоро вернусь.
examples.trans: Right, no noise. I'll be back soon.

meanings.note: до вечера = until the evening; вечером = in the evening

examples.text: Добрый вечер, Вика. С Новым годом!
examples.trans: Good evening, Vika. Happy New Year!

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence
Core Russian part meaning 'even' in everyday speech.
plural-only noun; предвыборные дебаты = televised election debates

examples.trans: Mom, we were at the debate!
The decisive debate will take place tomorrow.

examples.text: Посмотрим, придёт ли этот кандидат на дебаты!
examples.trans: We will see whether this candidate comes to the debate!

meanings.note: много дел = a lot to do

examples.trans: I have a lot to do.

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.
We could open a salon for you.

examples.text: Для вас можно открыть салон красоты.
examples.trans: We could open a beauty salon for you.

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)

examples.text: Жадность, Паша, должна быть умеренная. Комнатной температуры.
examples.trans: Greed, Pasha, should be moderate. Room temperature.

meanings.note: Prefix 'до-' marks reaching a boundary or finishing the remainder of an action (stem 'пить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to finish drinking', paired with 'допивать'.

examples.trans: You didn't even finish your tea.
He finished his coffee and stood up.

examples.text: Но вы даже не допили чай.
examples.trans: But you did not even finish your tea.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'быть'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to forget', paired with 'забывать'.

examples.trans: Don't forget to wash the toilet.

examples.text: Сейчас будешь чинить трубу. И унитаз не забудь помыть.
examples.trans: Now you're going to fix the pipe. And don't forget to wash the toilet.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.
There's someone here to see you.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, извините, тут к вам человек.
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, I'm sorry, there's a man here to see you.

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

meanings.note: Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'писать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to write', paired with 'писать'.

examples.text: А зачем? Я сам сделал так, чтобы он его написал.
examples.trans: And why would I? I'm the one who made him write it.

meanings.note: наш, наша, наше, наши; agrees with the noun

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.

посидеть.gloss: to sit for a while; to stay (with someone)

meanings.note: посиди с ним = stay with him

examples.trans: Stay with Vika for a while.
Let's sit in a café for a bit.

examples.text: Слушай, я уеду на полтора часа. Ты с Викой посиди, понял?
examples.trans: Listen, I'm going out for an hour and a half. You stay with Vika, got it?

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('beautiful, wonderful').

examples.text: Посмотри, какой у нас город прекрасный. Озёра, луга.
examples.trans: Look what a beautiful town we have. Lakes, meadows.

meanings.note: просить прощения = to ask for forgiveness

examples.text: Когда вырасту, ты будешь просить у меня прощения!
examples.trans: When I grow up, you'll be begging me to forgive you!

meanings.note: просить прощения = to ask for forgiveness, apologise

examples.trans: He is asking me to forgive him.

examples.text: Когда вырасту, ты будешь просить у меня прощения!
examples.trans: When I grow up, you'll be begging me to forgive you!

examples.text: У нас с тобой серьёзный разговор.
examples.trans: You and I have a serious talk to have.

examples.text: Есть интересный разговор. Всё хорошо, малыш.
examples.trans: There's an interesting conversation. Everything is fine, kid.

examples.text: Я должен написать речь для Самсонова.
examples.trans: I must write a speech for Samsonov.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'коро'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Так, не шумим. Я скоро вернусь.
examples.trans: Right, no noise. I'll be back soon.

examples.text: Я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: That's not what I mean at all.

examples.text: Нет, Вика, я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: No, Vika, that's not what I mean at all.

examples.text: Вы, к сожалению, не в моём вкусе.
examples.trans: Unfortunately, you are not my type.

examples.text: Я бы рад вам помочь. Но вы, к сожалению, не в моём вкусе.
examples.trans: I would be glad to help you. But unfortunately you are not my type.

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?

examples.trans: Now I'm the boss of our building site. You're fired!

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.

meanings.en: to leave, to go away (on foot)
